summary: Collector road kerb, no parking convention, homes close behind the kerb.
reasons: Through road, no parked cars along kerb
Homes and sheds within about 15 m

best_section.where: south kerb of Jerrang Street on the bend, beside the grassy verge

drivers.seclusion: Houses and sheds sit 10-20 m behind the kerb on this side; none mapped in OSM, so the count is from imagery.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow grass verge on the bend, no gravel or sealed pull-off visible; lane has no marked parking bay.
drivers.traffic: Collector road with traffic to the roundabout and motorway.
drivers.convention: One ute at the kerb near 25 m in the QLD image, none in Esri; no marked parking lane.

flags: Slope up to 9.6% at the western end, about 3% at the best section
sun_shade: Open to sun; tall trees across the road shade it from the north in the morning.
cannot_judge: Exact house distances, as OSM has no buildings here
